overclaims: Some people, Marcus included, describe tool-using LLM systems as neurosymbolic hybrids.
Because there is no deadline, the fact that displacement has not happened yet does not refute the claim.
Independent measurements showing that neurosymbolic systems lead in deployment or research output would also settle it.
checks.note: The packet does not support attributing the tool-use definition to Marcus. Finding no decisive evidence of displacement does not establish that displacement has not happened. The resolution summary also weakens the frozen threshold: leadership in research output alone is not sufficient to establish displacement across leading products and research.
